pricingSummary: Clockify is the best free option with unlimited users. Toggl Track offers the best experience for billable hourly work. Harvest combines time tracking with invoicing. Timely AI tracking is worth 14 dollars/mo for freelancers who hate manual entry.

faqs.question: How do freelancers track billable hours?
faqs.answer: Freelancers use time tracking software to log hours spent on each client project. Toggl Track and Clockify offer one-click timers with billable rate settings. At month-end, generate a report showing hours per project and invoice accordingly.

faqs.question: Is Clockify really free?
faqs.answer: Yes, Clockify is completely free with unlimited users, projects, and time entries. They make money from paid add-ons like Timesheet Approval, Kiosk Mode, and GPS tracking. For basic time tracking, it is 100% free.

faqs.question: Which time tracker integrates with QuickBooks?
faqs.answer: Harvest, Toggl Track, and Clockify all integrate with QuickBooks. Harvest has the deepest integration, automatically creating invoices from tracked time. Toggl and Clockify sync time entries to QuickBooks projects.

faqs.question: Can I track time offline?
faqs.answer: Toggl Track, Clockify, and Harvest all work offline on mobile and desktop. Time entries sync when you reconnect. This is essential for freelancers who work from coffee shops or areas with spotty internet.

faqs.question: How much time should I track as a freelancer?
faqs.answer: Track every billable hour plus 15-30 minutes daily for admin, communication, and business development. Most freelancers underestimate non-billable time by 30%. Tracking everything gives you accurate profitability data.
